_howto: Headlines for the scrolling updates bar (site-ticker.js). Add new items at the top. Fields: id (unique, never reuse), date (YYYY-MM-DD), tag (Lesson | Exam | Tool | Update | Soon), text (keep under ~60 characters), href (a site path starting with /). Items older than 90 days drop off automatically; at most 8 show. A new top item brings the bar back for visitors who closed it.
